title: URLs, percent-encoding and query strings
hints: Peel the URL from the outside in: the scheme before `://`, then the fragment after `#`, then the query after `?`, then split what is left at the first `/` into the authority (host and port) and the path.
In `parseQuery`, replace `+` with a space **before** percent-decoding, so an encoded `%2B` survives as a real plus sign.
